title: One in Ten Billion

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: Trump called the Iran war 'effectively over' as the blockade stayed, missiles flew at Riyadh, and a boat sank off Senegal. Talks resume in Abu Dhabi, and CERN finally caught a one-in-ten-billion decay.

lines: He says the war is over now,
Riyadh's sky says it's not true.
A boat went down off Senegal,
the sand gave way on Gaza's tents,
and Abu Dhabi tries round three.
